name: adhd-mess-types
title: The 4 ADHD mess types (and the first fix for each)
description: The four ADHD mess types: Doom Piler, Floordrobe Keeper, Out-of-Sight Out-of-Mind, and Churn and Burn. What each looks like and the one card to start with.

faq.q: Can I be more than one ADHD mess type?
faq.a: Yes, and most people are. The types describe the shape your mess takes most often, not a personality. Pick the one that matches the room bothering you most right now, use its first card, and come back for the next type when that one feels handled.

No. The mess types are a Neurotidy framework for choosing a starting point, built from patterns in more than 21,000 ADHD threads. They do not diagnose ADHD or anything else. A messy room on its own says nothing about whether you have ADHD.
